videos.title: 3 Deeds That Never Stop
videos.title_en: 3 Deeds That Keep Counting After You Die
videos.caption: When you die, your deeds stop… except 3 🤍 Which one are you building? Comment 1, 2 or 3 👇

sources.wording: faithful rendering of the Riyad as-Salihin / Sahih Muslim English translation

lines.text: Right now, every good deed you do is being {written}.
lines.text2: ابھی آپ کی ہر نیکی {لکھی} جا رہی ہے۔
lines.say: Right now, | every good deed you do is being written.

lines.text2: لیکن جب آپ مریں گے تو یہ {رک جائے گا}۔

lines.say: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: or a {righteous child} who prays for you.
lines.text2: یا {نیک اولاد} جو آپ کے لیے دعا کرے۔
lines.say: or a righteous child | who prays for you.

lines.text: These keep {adding} to your deeds, even in the grave.
lines.text2: یہ قبر میں بھی آپ کی نیکیوں میں {اضافہ} کرتے رہیں گے۔
lines.say: These keep adding to your deeds, | even in the grave.

lines.label: Allah says
lines.text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا وَآثَارَهُمْ
lines.sub: “Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind.” (Ya-Sin 36:12)
lines.say: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life, | and record what they have put forth, and what they left behind.

lines.text: Which one are you building? Comment {1, 2 or 3}.
lines.text2: آپ کون سا بنا رہے ہیں؟ {1، 2 یا 3} لکھیں۔
lines.say: Which one are you building? | Comment one, two, or three.
